text.mine-lights.about.title: MineLights
text.mine-lights.about.support_intro: if u liek dis mod, plz consider supportin its development:
text.mine-lights.about.kofi: buy me a cheezburger on Ko-fi
text.mine-lights.about.description: MineLights iz a Minecraft mod dat bringz shiny RGB lightz to Minecraft Java Edition.
option.mine-lights.enableMod.tooltip: turnz all teh shiny lightz from dis mod on an off.
option.mine-lights.autoStartServer.toolt: if enabled, teh mod will automaticly start an installed MineLights Server if it isn't runnin. with manual server management enabled, u must install MineLights Server first.
option.mine-lights.manualServerManagemen:
when enabled, teh mod does not download or replace MineLights Server.
it can still start a server u installed when automatically start server is enabled.
option.mine-lights.notifyMissingServer.t:
in manual server management mode, shows an in-game installation
message when MineLights Server is missing.
option.mine-lights.checkServerUpdates.to:
in manual server management mode, checks for releases n shows
new versions n their changelog in chat. install updates manually.
option.mine-lights.refresh_devices.label: REFRESH DEVICE LIST
option.mine-lights.refresh_devices.toolt:
if u plug in a new device while game is runnin,
check dis an save to make it appear in teh list.
option.mine-lights.restart.label: RESTART SERVER
option.mine-lights.restart_admin.label: RESTART SERVER AS BIG BOSS
option.mine-lights.device.header: enabl or disabl specific shiny devicez below:
option.mine-lights.clear_disabled.label: RE-ENABL ALL DEVICEZ
option.mine-lights.clear_disabled.toolti: check dis box to clear teh list of all disabld devicez.
option.mine-lights.enableSaturationBar.t:
shows ur food saturation on %s.
switches to ur air level when underwater.
change teh keyz in key layout.
option.mine-lights.enableLocatorBar.tool:
shows other players n waypointz in front of u as kolored dots on %s.
change teh keyz in key layout.
option.mine-lights.alwaysShowCompass.too:
if enabld, teh compass effect will alwayz show teh standard compass
(pointin to world spawn), even if u dun hav one.
it will be overriden if u pik up any compass.
option.mine-lights.compassPriority.toolt: decidez which compass to display if multiple typez r in ur inventory.
option.mine-lights.highlightMovementKeys: highlightz WASD, Sprint, Sneak, an Jump keyz.
option.mine-lights.pulseChatKey.tooltip: Wen teh meowssage comes, teh chat button blinkz 3 tiemz
option.mine-lights.enableBiomeEffects.to: setz a base keyboard color based on teh biome u r in.
option.mine-lights.dimmingMode.tooltip: Choos how teh wurld glowz getz dimmed by teh shinyz.
addz rain an thundersturm lightin effectz.
option.mine-lights.mirrorRamRainDirectio: flips rain direction on ram devices.
MAEK PURPLE FLASHY LIEK IN END PLACE.
option.mine-lights.enableInWaterEffect.t: highlightz move keyz with a blu color when submerged.
option.mine-lights.force_update.label: Check 4 New Servr Stuff
option.mine-lights.force_update.tooltip:
checks github for a MineLights Server update.
automatic management can download updates; manual management shows installation details in chat.
text.mine-lights.server.restart_from_tra: teh v2 server is shared wif other clients n software. restart or stop it frum its system tray menu.
option.mine-lights.minBrightness.tooltip:
minimum brite-ness for environmental effects when dimming is enabled.
0 = completely dark; 1 = full brite-ness.
text.mine-lights.key_layout.help: choose which keyz each effect lights up. click "+ add keyz", then press teh keyz on ur keyboard in order (teh first key is teh start of teh bar), n press Esc when u're done. changes apply when u click save.
option.mine-lights.effectConfigHelp: ENTER KEY NAMES SEPARATED BY COMMAS N KOLORZ AS #RRGGBB. LED OVERRIDES USE Device name|index=KEY; SEPARATE MULTIPLE OVERRIDES WIF SEMICOLONS. USE none TO CLEAR A LIST OR PROFILE.
option.mine-lights.healthBarKeys.tooltip:
keyz that show ur health, frum empty to full.
ur 20 health is split evenly across teh keyz.
option.mine-lights.hungerBarKeys.tooltip: keyz that show ur hunger, frum empty to full.
option.mine-lights.saturationBarKeys.too: keyz that show saturation, or air while underwater.
option.mine-lights.experienceBarKeys.too:
keyz that show progress towards ur next level.
each key fills up gradually.
option.mine-lights.heartbeatRedKeys.tool:
keyz that pulse like a heartbeat when ur health is low.
default draws a heart shape in teh middle of teh keyboard.
option.mine-lights.heartbeatWhiteKeys.to:
keyz that pulse white along wif teh heartbeat.
default is teh shine on teh heart (R Y G).
option.mine-lights.compassKeys.tooltip:
keyz around teh compass, clockwise starting frum straight ahead.
usually 8 keyz; any number works.
option.mine-lights.compassCenterKey.tool: key in teh middle of teh compass ring.
option.mine-lights.ledOverrides.tooltip:
rename leds a device reports wrongly.
format: Device name|LED index=KEY
example: Keychron|1=F1
device name matches any device whose name contains it.
led indexes are in teh game log.
option.mine-lights.locatorBarKeys.toolti:
keyz used for teh locator bar, left to right.
teh middle key is straight ahead; teh ends are 60 degrees to each side.
option.mine-lights.locatorDotSize.toolti:
how many keyz a dot bleeds over, for teh closest waypointz.
farther waypointz get smaller dots, in teh same 4 steps as teh vanilla bar. 0.5 to 5.
option.mine-lights.restoreLightingOutsid:
on teh title screen, while loading, or after quitting,
hand OpenRGB devices back to ur normal lighting.
off: everything turns red outside of a world.
option.mine-lights.outsideWorldProfile.t:
name of an OpenRGB profile to load outside of a world
(save one in OpenRGB wif ur usual lighting).
leave blank to restore teh mode each device had when MineLights connected.
option.mine-lights.experienceLocatorMode:
merged: works exactly like teh bar above ur hotbar. teh keyz show
teh xp bar whenever teh screen does (no one tracked, or for a
few seconds after u gain xp) n teh locator bar teh rest of teh time.
both: locator dots are drawn on top of teh xp bar.
option.mine-lights.enableAbsorptionOverl:
absorption hearts (golden apple, enchanted golden apple, totem)
turn teh health keyz gold, frum teh start of teh bar,
one key per teh same amount of health as a red key.
option.mine-lights.lowHealthThreshold.to:
teh low health heartbeat starts below this much health.
2 health = 1 heart. default 10 (5 hearts).
text.mine-lights.keys.none: no keyz: this effect won't show anywhere.
text.mine-lights.keys.capturing: press keyz in order, Esc when done: %s
text.mine-lights.keys.unknown: %s isn't a normal key (media keyz aren't). if ur keyboard has an fn key, hold it to press F1-F12.
option.mine-lights.healthBarKeys.descrip: fills red wif ur health; golden hearts turn keyz gold. flashes white when u're hit, gray when withering, yellow-green when poisoned.
option.mine-lights.hungerBarKeys.descrip: fills orange wif ur food level (20 drumsticks split across teh keyz).
option.mine-lights.saturationBarKeys.des: lime wif ur hidden saturation; turns light blue n shows ur air while ur head is underwater n until it refills. not used if saturation is merged into teh hunger bar (player status).
option.mine-lights.experienceBarKeys.des: fills green as u earn xp n resets when u level up.
option.mine-lights.locatorBarKeys.descri: other players n waypointz in front of u show as dots in their own locator bar kolor, on a dark bar like in game. brighter means up, darker means down.
option.mine-lights.locatorDotSize.descri: bigger dots glow onto more neighboring keyz. like teh vanilla bar, dots shrink in 4 steps between 128 n 332 blocks away; past that they are a single key.
option.mine-lights.heartbeatRedKeys.desc: pulses in teh heartbeat kolor below teh low health threshold (player status). teh default keyz form a heart: 4 5 6 7 / e t u / d f h / v b / space.
option.mine-lights.heartbeatWhiteKeys.de: white shine drawn on top of teh heart while it pulses.
option.mine-lights.compassKeys.descripti: when u hold a compass, teh key in teh target's direction lights up. press teh ring keyz clockwise starting frum teh one for straight ahead. default: numpad 8 9 6 3 2 1 4 7.
option.mine-lights.compassCenterKey.desc: shows teh compass kolor, n pulses when u're within 8 blocks of teh target. default: numpad 5.
option.mine-lights.ledOverrides.descript: only needed when a device names an led wrongly, like a keyboard whose f1 reports as "brite-ness down". led numbers are in teh game log (logs/latest.log).
text.mine-lights.colors.help: each bar fades frum its empty kolor to its full kolor as it fills.
option.mine-lights.absorptionColor.toolt: kolor of health keyz covered by absorption (golden) hearts.
option.mine-lights.airColor.tooltip: saturation keyz while underwater, for air u still have.
option.mine-lights.airDimColor.tooltip: saturation keyz while underwater, for air u've used up.
option.mine-lights.experienceDimColor.to: xp keyz when not filled yet.
option.mine-lights.heartbeatColor.toolti: kolor of teh low health heartbeat at its brightest.
option.mine-lights.saturationTintStrengt:
how much saturation tints teh hunger keyz when merged.
0 = no tint, 1 = full saturation kolor. default 0.25.
option.mine-lights.mergeSaturationIntoHu: MERGE SATURATION & AIR INTO HUNGER BAR

shows saturation n air on teh hunger keyz instead of their own keyz.
saturation tints teh hunger keyz it covers (like appleskin).
underwater, n until ur air refills, teh hunger keyz show air instead,
like teh bubbles that appear above teh hunger bar.
teh saturation / air keyz are left free.
option.mine-lights.locatorBarColor.toolt:
kolor of teh locator keyz behind teh waypoint dots
(teh dark bar u see in game).
